home.hero.title: A Brazilian community that runs game servers and builds software.
home.hero.lead: We are gamers and technology enthusiasts. Everything here is free, runs on voluntary donations, and nothing is for sale.
home.purpose.title: Purpose
home.what.title: What we do
home.what.servers.title: Game servers
home.what.servers.body: We host game servers for our members. Minecraft is live; Palworld, Project Zomboid and Factorio are coming soon.
home.what.bots.title: Discord bots
home.what.bots.body: EmpireMuse plays music in voice channels. EmpireBot, in development, will connect Discord to our game servers.
home.what.community.title: Community
home.what.community.body: A friendly place {channels}, where members talk and request new games.
home.projects.title: Projects
home.servers.title: Game servers
home.funding.title: How we are funded
home.funding.body: EmpireCommunity runs on voluntary donations. The first milestone is R$ 3,000, to build our own server, with a Xeon and 128 GB of RAM, to host more game servers. After that, community costs continue: server power, upgrades, hosting and domains. Money donations are not open yet.
home.join.title: Join us.
join.title: How to join
join.lead: EmpireCommunity is open to anyone who enjoys games and technology.
join.do.title: What you can do
join.do.play.title: Play
join.do.request.title: Request a game
join.do.contribute.title: Contribute
join.do.contribute.body: Part of our code is public, on GitHub.
join.do.support.title: Support us
join.do.support.body: Donations are voluntary and help keep everything running.
join.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
join.faq.paid.a: No. Everything is free and nothing is for sale. The community runs on voluntary donations.
join.faq.abroad.q: I don't live in Brazil. Can I join?
join.faq.abroad.a: Yes, on Discord. That is where we talk with people from other countries.
join.faq.contact.q: How do I reach the team?
join.faq.contact.a: Discord is the fastest way. You can also write to {email}.
